Black Powder Avenger.description: At 1st level, the Black Powder Avenger chooses either the pistol or musket as the instrument of his vengeance. The character sacrifices one point of Wisdom; from the moment the sacrifice is made, the character gains a bonus to attack and damage of +1 when firing his signature weapon. This bonus increases by +1 at levels 4, 7, and 10 (maximum +4). Most Black Powder Avengers give their signature weapon a name and treat it as if their lives depended on it.

Black Powder Avenger.title: Black Crafts
Black Powder Avenger.description: Starting at 1st level, the Black Powder Avenger is able to prepare a number of supplies to aid him in his quest as a wizard would prepare his spells. The Black Powder Avenger knows all his available crafts for his given level.

Black Powder Avenger.title: Signature Weapon II
Black Powder Avenger.description: Attack and damage bonus improves to + 2.

Black Powder Avenger.title: Signature Critical
Black Powder Avenger.description: The Black Powder Avenger gains an additional +1 to the threat range of their signature weapon.

Black Powder Avenger.title: Signature Weapon III
Black Powder Avenger.description: Attack and damage bonus improves to + 3.

Black Powder Avenger.title: Evasion
Black Powder Avenger.description: A successful Reflex save for half damage results in no damage.

Black Powder Avenger.title: Detonation (3x/day)
Black Powder Avenger.description: "Overtamp" signature weapon to gain +4 attack bonus and maximize ranged damage. Weapon must be repaired after.

Black Powder Avenger.title: Signature Weapon IV
Black Powder Avenger.description: Attack and damage bonus improves to + 4.

Hallowed Witch.title: Minor Witchcraft Ability
Hallowed Witch.description: Cast a minor spell as a spell-like ability 3 times / day.

Hallowed Witch.title: Weave Protection
Hallowed Witch.description: Gain spell resistance equal to 10 + class level / 2.

Hallowed Witch.title: Medium Witchcraft Ability
Hallowed Witch.description: Cast a medium spell as a spell-like ability 2 times / day.

Hallowed Witch.title: Major Witchcraft Ability
Hallowed Witch.description: Cast a major spell as a spell-like ability 1 time / day.

Shifter.title: Improved Wild Shape II
Shifter.description: Can change into a harpy, minotaur, or gargoyle.

Shifter.title: Improved Wild Shape III
Shifter.description: Can change into a basilisk, drider, or manticore.

Shifter.title: Humanoid Shape
Shifter.description: Can change into a drow, lizardfolk, or kobold.

Shifter.title: Evershifting Form
Shifter.description: Racial type changes to Shapechanger. Can change forms at will.

Shifter.title: Improved Wild Shape IV
Shifter.description: Can change into a dire tiger, medusa, or mindflayer.

Pale Master.title: Animate Dead
Pale Master.description: Cast Animate Dead as a spell-like ability.

Pale Master.title: Darkvision
Pale Master.description: Able to see in unlit areas.

Pale Master.title: Deathless Vigor
Pale Master.description: +3 Hit Points per level. This change is not retroactive.

Pale Master.title: Paralyzing Touch (Graft)
Pale Master.description: Perform a touch attack that can paralyze an opponent.

Pale Master.title: Undead Graft (1x/day)
Pale Master.description: Gain an undead arm that can perform special attacks.

Pale Master.title: Undead Graft Strength
Pale Master.description: The undead arm provides a permanent +4 Strength bonus.

Pale Master.title: Weakening Touch (Graft)
Pale Master.description: Perform a touch attack that drains an opponent's Strength.

Pale Master.title: Destructive Touch (Graft)
Pale Master.description: Perform a touch attack that drains an opponent's Constitution.

Pale Master.title: Undead Graft II
Pale Master.description: Paralyze touch can be used three times a day.

Pale Master.title: Degenerative Touch (Graft)
Pale Master.description: Perform a touch attack that causes level drain.

Pale Master.title: Deathless Master's Touch (Graft)
Pale Master.description: Perform a touch attack that can kill instantly.

People's Champion.title: Proficiencies
People's Champion.description: Proficient with simple and martial weapons, light armor, medium armor, heavy armor, and shields.

People's Champion.title: Eye for Detail
People's Champion.description: +2 bonus to Appraise, Listen, Search and Spot checks.

People's Champion.title: Righteous Anger
People's Champion.description: Once per day add Wisdom modifier to attack and damage (minimum +1); this lasts for one turn, plus one round per level of People's Champion.

People's Champion.title: Aura of Confidence
People's Champion.description: +4 bonus on saving throws vs. fear. At will, grant nearby allies a +1 bonus on attack and saving throws vs. fear.

People's Champion.title: Unyielding Devotion
People's Champion.description: +4 bonus on saving throws vs. mind-affecting.

Shadowdancer.title: Proficiencies
Shadowdancer.description: Proficient with simple weapons and light armor.

Shadowdancer.title: Hide in Plain Sight
Shadowdancer.description: Can hide even while being observed.

Shadowdancer.title: Darkvision
Shadowdancer.description: Able to see in unlit areas.

Shadowdancer.title: Evasion
Shadowdancer.description: A successful Reflex save for half damage results in no damage.

Shadowdancer.title: Uncanny Dodge I
Shadowdancer.description: Retain Dexterity bonus to AC, even when flat-footed.

Shadowdancer.title: Shadow Daze
Shadowdancer.description: Inflict an illusory daze upon an enemy.

Shadowdancer.title: Shadow Evade
Shadowdancer.description: Temporary AC, concealment and damage reduction bonuses.

Shadowdancer.title: Defensive Roll
Shadowdancer.description: Avoid killing blows with a Reflex save.

Shadowdancer.title: Uncanny Dodge II
Shadowdancer.description: +1 bonus on reflex saves vs traps. Grants immunity to sneak attacks from a flanking attacker unless the attacker has at least four more combined class levels of rogue, assassin, barbarian, and shadowdancer than the defender.

Shadowdancer.title: Slippery Mind
Shadowdancer.description: Failed Will saving throws get an automatic re-roll.

Shadowdancer.title: Improved Evasion
Shadowdancer.description: Take half damage even on a failed Reflex save.

Shadowdancer.title: Uncanny Dodge III
Shadowdancer.description: +2 bonus on Reflex saves vs. traps.

Dragon Disciple.title: Breath Weapon 2d10
Dragon Disciple.description: Breathe a cone of elemental damage depending on color.

Dragon Disciple.title: Hit Die (d8)
Dragon Disciple.description: Roll d8 for hit points. This change is not retroactive.

Dragon Disciple.title: Hit Die (d10)
Dragon Disciple.description: Roll d10 for hit points. This change is not retroactive.

Dragon Disciple.title: Darkvision
Dragon Disciple.description: Able to see in unlit areas.

Dragon Disciple.title: Immune to one elemental damage type depending on color
Immune to sleep. Racial type changes to Dragon
